cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The dishes are done. Dry your hands and sit down, please. We're still barely speaking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stayed to clean up. I've done that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct. That's the kitchen finished. Don't sign us off with it; tell me whether you still want to come back tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've only got ten minutes before I need to leave for the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me five. One question, one answer; we can manage that properly. Please sit where I can hear you, not halfway through the door.
